review_notes: Independently reviewed the current top-level proposal.json in full, functionality.md, both disposition ledgers, coverage.json, and unresolved.json. The current seven-write proposal, rather than the older five-write proposal embedded in context, is the subject of this verdict.
Read both complete owned files in canonical and rendered form, all three subjects pages, and the complete links page. Rendered aliases were not used as independent semantic evidence.

All seven proposed writes concern owned subjects and are supported. They correct universal randomization and attachment claims, callback classification, historical CPU storage/type aliases, and per-effect ownership implications. No additional retained-fact correction requiring a new write was identified.

Verified spawn-kind numeric assignments against EF_SpawnKind and the executing efAsync consumer. Vector/scalar arguments are copied into request storage; the joint pointer is retained. Deferred versus immediate execution is selected by the current GObj and the strict s_link < 9 boundary.

Checked every dispatcher case against the functionality narrative, including 0x438/0x439 normalization, the 0x49D angular input, 0x513..0x515 camera routing, negative IDs, the 0x250 boundary, quotient interval 30000..30999, and random/state side effects before unsupported-ID reporting.

Verified CPU bytes against canonical writers, enum assignments, and the active signed-byte interpreter. Successful construction appends 17 bytes without reset or activation; writer assertions can occur after partial construction. The -80 facing-relative input and waits are interpreter behavior, not an inferred named gameplay maneuver.

Retained conceptual links describe supported, nonexclusive relationships. Their historical baseline records are preserved exactly; current canonical evidence supplies the justification. Both duplicate CPU-scripting edges remain individually accounted for.

Acceptance does not establish compiled section placement, register identities, complete effect teardown safety, original descriptive names, or exceptional target math results. Those claims remain explicitly deferred.

fact_dispositions.reason: Arithmetic consumers are visible, but neither section association nor compiled immutability follows from source literals. Historical matching assertions are not supplied compiled evidence.
The literal values occur in source; pool placement, ordering, and read-only section type require compiled evidence.
Function-level arithmetic purpose is supported, but attribution to the .sdata2 subject is not proved.
The proposed data-flow write correctly distinguishes unchanged offsets in kind 7 and 0x49D, request queue storage, copied parameters, and camera requests.
The proposed mapping preserves animation-driven graphics while correctly avoiding universal persistent joint attachment and including world-position effects and quakes.
Supported as an explicitly speculative descriptive alias by the direct animation caller and diagnostic, not as an original name.
The proposed type write matches the declaration, identifies the unused final float and special angular vector use, and appropriately leaves callback registration unestablished.
Accurate dispatcher purpose. Asynchronous names the receiving API rather than promising deferred execution, and resolving a joint does not imply every outcome remains attached.
Correct normal-state behavior. The five-entry cycle assumes an initially valid index because the read precedes wrapping; all non-ground states preserve the initialized zero floor angle.
The proposed write preserves the exact 17-byte append and replaces obsolete x1A88 naming with fp->cpu.write_pos, including initialized-cursor and per-byte-bound preconditions.
The executing interpreter reads signed operands and applies the facing comparison, proving backward horizontal input for normal facing. Neutral refers to the left stick, not all controller inputs.
The proposed write correctly uses void(Fighter*) and canonical struct CpuFighter through fp->cpu without asserting historical type identity or compiled offsets.
The fixed terminated script and left-stick purpose are proved jointly by emitted bytes, enum assignments, writers, and active interpreter.
Correct for successful construction and subsequent interpretation. There is no local guard, but callees can assert; waits denote interpreter ticks and activation is separate.
The broad description of both data flows is correct and does not require all branches to randomize or remain attached.
The proposed TU mapping correctly distinguishes joint-forwarding, world-position, and camera requests while including the independently verified CPU script constructor.
Accurate two-function translation-unit purpose, supported by the complete owned body and canonical CPU emitters.
The proposed write correctly identifies a fighter-wide marker consumed under KeepGfx gating, the normal-cycle precondition, and random/state changes before unsupported-ID reporting.
